firsthand_problem.instructions: Does `comment` describe a problem, difficulty, or frustration that the author personally experienced?

criteria.true: The author says they themselves ran into the problem (for example 'I', 'we', 'my team', 'our company').
criteria.false: No problem is described, or it is about other people, hypothetical, a general opinion, or a sales pitch.

criteria.firsthand_account: The author describes their own experience.
criteria.secondhand_report: The author reports what happened to someone else.
criteria.general_opinion: A view or argument without a personal account.
criteria.product_pitch: Promotes a product, service, or project the author is connected to.
criteria.joke_or_sarcasm: Humor or sarcasm; not meant literally.
criteria.question_or_request: Mainly asks a question or asks for help or recommendations.

domain.instructions: Which area is the main subject of `comment` about?

criteria.software_development: Writing, testing, reviewing, or shipping code; languages, frameworks, IDEs.
criteria.infrastructure_ops: Cloud, servers, deployment, networking, monitoring, IT administration.
criteria.data_ml_ai: Data engineering, analytics, machine learning, AI models and tools.
criteria.product_design: Product decisions, UX, UI, design tools.
criteria.business_operations: Running a company: operations, internal tools, vendors, processes.
criteria.finance_payments: Payments, accounting, invoicing, banking, taxes, personal finance.
criteria.sales_marketing: Sales, marketing, growth, advertising, SEO, customer acquisition.
criteria.work_careers: Hiring, jobs, careers, management, remote work, productivity at work.
criteria.legal_government: Law, regulation, compliance, government services, policy.
criteria.consumer_tech: Consumer apps, devices, platforms, and services as an end user.
criteria.health_medical: Health, medicine, fitness, health care systems.
criteria.media_publishing: News, writing, publishing, video, music, creators.
criteria.home_life: Housing, family, transport, daily life outside work.
criteria.other: A clear subject that fits none of the above.
criteria.mixed: Two or more of the above equally.
criteria.unclear: The subject cannot be determined from the text.
